## Desired result

What should the user be able to do? For a bug, include the trigger, expected behavior, and actual behavior.

## Scope and acceptance

What needs to be true to call this complete? Link the relevant example, feature record, or shared task.

## Coordination

Record the assignee, branch, dependencies, and eventual PR. Keep private project data and credentials out of issue attachments.
